description: Note Taker is a local macOS desktop app that turns highlights from books into a personal, git-backed knowledge base. The user photographs yellow-highlighted pages of physical books (or pastes Kindle highlight text), drops a batch of photos into an Electron app, reviews and edits drafts extracted by a configurable OCR (Tesseract) or local vision model (Ollama), and pushes approved highlights as markdown sections appended to one file per book (`books/<slug>.md`) in a GitHub repo they own, so they can recall a book's takeaways and apply them at work.

features.evidence: Commits 17694d0, 1ff6c39; hardened in final wave b082614 (timeouts, no stdin, no token env, literal pathspecs). tests/test_git_publisher.py against a real bare remote. Review (opus) found rollback leaving a dirty clone, deleting outside the repo, and is_dirty missing untracked files → all fixed.

features.evidence: Commits 22b21c1, e765e85; final wave 1c496aa, 333a49e, f27f2ce. tests/test_push_service.py, test_push_recovery.py (real git, concurrent pushes, crash recovery, idempotent markers). Mid-push edit snapshot compare; atomic delete_if; branch/remote guard.

features.evidence: Commits af6233d, d8cd761. tests/test_extraction_*.py, test_imaging.py (rotation, EXIF, outcome gating, per-run claim tokens). The Tesseract-OSD rotation test is SKIPPED here (tesseract not installed).

features.name: Ollama vision extractor
features.evidence: Commit 1c52a7e. tests/test_ollama_extractor.py with respx (request body, schema without bbox, timeouts, error mapping). NEVER run against a real Ollama: default model qwen2.5vl:7b and the structured-output schema (nullable unions) are untested; live tests (-m live) are deselected.

features.name: Tesseract highlight-mask extractor
features.evidence: Commit 2d5a856. tests/test_tesseract_extractor.py (OpenCV region finding on synthetic images, passage grouping, page-number choice, error mapping via an _ocr seam). NEVER run with the real tesseract binary (not installed): OCR quality and the default yellow HSV range on real photos are unverified; the real-binary test is skipped.

features.evidence: Commits c23b8d4, 1874c13; final wave 799ff32. tests/test_janitor.py. Review found a stale warned_at from an earlier window could delete a batch without a fresh warning → warning must belong to the current window; janitor now skips batches in `pushing`.
